runtimeMapping.basic: Original two Attack events against a retained victim; one offensive SP per basic attack.
runtimeMapping.S1: Ready SP expands x-4 acquisition before the AUTO trigger. Two original events hit capped ground targets. Full cast locks SP. Target selection at release, retained recipients between two events.
runtimeMapping.S2: Original first Skill_2 event selects the rank cap. Native check_block chooses two or three 0.01-second derived damage triggers based on any blocker. Two charges and partial recovery; full cast locks SP.
runtimeMapping.S3: Original Begin leads to ten timed rank-blackboard damage rounds and three force1 pulls, then End event damage and force2 pull. Ground/aerial rank cap selected afresh. 0.6708 pull dead zone. Loop-only invulnerability/stun/freeze rejection.
runtimeMapping.T1: Per calculation Dice/AtkScaleUp; DISARMED_COMBAT before damage. S2/S3 mark guarantees the selected talent multiplier.
runtimeMapping.T2: LOW_PRIORITY check after T1, selected DEF penetration through output damage; derived state persists through dodge.

verificationLimits: Compiled Unity C# ability lifecycle/event dispatch and same-frame order have not been recovered or frame-certified.
S3 uses the native Begin duration, a3-second fixed blackboard loop and native End duration/event. Original handoff/overlap, cooldown reset and animation recovery tail need game comparison.
Shared pull resolves weight/obstacles immediately; native linked-projectile flight, path collateral, source offset and exact collision geometry are not reproduced.

S1 retains the first release group for its second hit. S2 issued derived hits retain recipients, use current source ATK and lose guaranteed mark when interrupted; native rebasing and exact modifier lifetime need game comparison.
Stun/freeze immunity is represented by rejecting new catalogue statuses during the loop, not by native buff flag suppression/restoration.

Tremble uses the separate disarmedCombat immunity and prevents blocked ordinary attacks. Combat-interruption cooldown reset and attack-triggered enemy abilities beyond the two supported enemy types require native comparison.
Modules, original Unity particles/audio and full visual/frame parity remain unfinished.
